title: Make trusted Open Library qualification timeout observable and bounded
goal: Repair the trusted-main Open Library qualification harness so each real TiaV21Worker qualify-library invocation owns an explicit bounded timeout and can still publish sanitized BLOCKED evidence before the outer GitHub job timeout, without changing Siemens migration semantics or weakening the trusted Windows/TIA boundary.
scope: Primary-maintainer scope only: change exactly .github/workflows/tia-v21-library-qualification.yml. Do not modify src/TiaV21Worker, generator/product semantics, agents, other workflows, secrets, runner configuration, vendor payloads, or IndustrialMDE.
Preserve existing trigger authorization and trusted-main checkout semantics. Candidate or PR code must never execute on the Windows/TIA runner before independent review and merge.
Replace reliance on the outer job-level cancellation with an explicit bounded child-process execution contract for each TiaV21Worker.exe qualify-library invocation.
Use a finite per-invocation timeout and an outer Windows-job timeout large enough for two bounded invocations plus build, cleanup, sanitized evidence publication and final enforcement.

On invocation timeout, attempt best-effort termination of the worker/process tree, classify the result as sanitized BLOCKED rather than vendor qualification FAIL, and preserve publication of machine-readable evidence before final workflow failure.

Timeout evidence may identify only the bounded phase (run1/run2), trusted main identity, source archive basename/hash, generic timeout reason and other already-approved sanitized fields. Do not publish operator absolute paths, vendor payloads, raw manifests, raw stdout/stderr or raw Siemens exception details.

Preserve the successful-path OLQ-001 deterministic checks for source SHA256, TIA/Openness build identity, qualification identity, qualified archive basename/SHA256, native reopen success, process exit states and deterministic second run.
Do not change Openness UI/headless mode or library migration semantics. If a bounded trusted-main rerun later proves the worker itself is stalled, handle that as a separate worker-level task.

requirements: PR scope is exactly .github/workflows/tia-v21-library-qualification.yml and contains no unrelated protected/product/vendor/IndustrialMDE changes.
The Windows/TIA job remains main-only, explicitly checks out main with persist-credentials disabled and verifies checked-out HEAD equals current origin/main before build or execution.
workflow_dispatch remains authorized only from refs/heads/main and issue_comment remains authorized only for exact /run-olq-001 on issue #19 from repository owner al-gri.
Each qualify-library invocation runs as a controllable child process with a finite bounded timeout observable by the harness before the outer job timeout.
The outer job timeout is greater than the combined bounded invocation budget and leaves practical margin for build, hashing, cleanup, evidence publication and final enforcement.
Invocation timeout causes best-effort worker/process-tree termination and sanitized BLOCKED evidence; it must not be misreported as Siemens/vendor qualification FAIL.

Timeout and failure handling do not expose operator-controlled absolute paths, raw exception details, .zal19/.zal21 payloads, raw manifests or raw stdout/stderr to GitHub artifacts/comments/logs by design.
Source archive SHA256 is bound before TIA processing so timeout evidence can still identify the exact external source without exposing its path.
Normal completion preserves the existing deterministic two-run equality checks, native reopen requirement and PASS-only final enforcement.
Exact candidate receives green deterministic Linux CI and no Windows/TIA candidate execution occurs before merge.
Because primary ChatGPT materially authored the candidate, one fresh isolated chatgpt-secondary CODE_REVIEW APPROVE for the exact current candidate SHA is required before delegated merge.
tia: Windows/TIA execution is post-merge only from trusted main.
If a real invocation exceeds the bounded timeout, issue #19 receives explicit sanitized BLOCKED timeout evidence rather than missing-evidence generic FAIL.
If qualification completes normally, the original OLQ-001 deterministic source/build/qualification/archive/native-reopen acceptance gates remain unchanged.
